g1-implement.title: G1 beta degeneracy root-cause: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Build a self-contained diagnosis harness scripts/diagnose_compound_beta_degeneracy.py that: (a) loads the gold/production compound_prior fit on the per-season DBs (DB-only; reuse src/compound_prior fit machinery via CompoundPriorFitConfig with the gold config), (b) reproduces the production degenerate output (beta-spread ~0, gamma plateau) and prints the recovered beta/gamma ladder, (c) MEASURES which mechanism flattens beta by ablation: ridge_alpha sweep {0,1e-4,1e-3,1e-2,1e-1,1.0} reporting beta-spread + the per-parameter data information diag(X'WX) vs alpha (the S1.3 ridge-dominance check), monotone-gamma enforcement on/off, reference-compound/design differences vs the stdlib pooled fit (vendor the pooled FE method from prior-art so the script stands alone against main). Emit a JSON evidence file under .agent-work/issue-382-gamma-degeneracy/evidence/ with the numbers. Deliver a measured ROOT-CAUSE for beta degeneracy + fix-or-by-design statement. Do NOT change src/compound_prior behavior; do NOT touch the CompoundNormalizer/artifact schema (the #380 seam) — flag if implicated. Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF; dispatch constellation-implementer (model: sonnet). Integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with measured beta root-cause and no unresolved blockers

g2-implement.title: G2 measured gamma identifiability: implement
g2-implement.imperative: Extend the diagnosis harness (or a sibling scripts/diagnose_compound_gamma_identifiability.py) to MEASURE gamma identifiability, not assume it: (a) collinearity of each gamma regressor (tyre_life x compound indicator, after the within-(driver,race) demeaning that absorbs alpha) vs the absorbed fuel/track-evolution term (lap_number / phi) — report Pearson r and/or VIF per compound; (b) profile likelihood width and SE per gamma_c and the implied identifiable range (can the data distinguish gamma-up from a plateau? at how many SE?); (c) design condition number. Reuse src/compound_prior/identifiability.py where it fits. Emit JSON evidence with the numbers and a measured verdict: gamma recovered OR a quantified identification limit. DB-only; do not change production behavior; do not touch the #380 seam. Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF; dispatch constellation-implementer (model: sonnet). Integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
